title: The Organizing Practice

header.html: Explain the purpose of the organizing practice and its relationships with the principles; explain the purpose of the project management team structure, role descriptions and commercial management approach; define project board and project team; describe the three project interests, the PRINCE2 roles and the work breakdown structure
the official PRINCE2 7 Foundation syllabus (PeopleCert), learning outcome 4.2

toc.title: The project board and the project team

html:
1Purpose

The organizing practice defines the accountability structure of the project: who is responsible for what, and how everyone works together. It supports the principle define roles, responsibilities and relationships.

2The three project interests

Every project must represent three interests:

Interest Who speaks for it
Business The Executive (is the project worthwhile and good value?)
User The Senior User(s) (will the products meet the need?)
Supplier The Senior Supplier(s) (can the products be delivered as specified?)

3The project board and the project team

Term Meaning
Project board The group accountable for the project's success: Executive, Senior User(s) and Senior Supplier(s)
Project team The people who manage and deliver the project day to day: the project manager, team managers and team members (with support)

4The PRINCE2 roles

Role Responsibility
Executive Ultimately accountable for the project; owns the business case; chairs the board
Senior User Specifies the needs of users and ensures the products meet them
Senior Supplier Represents the suppliers; accountable for the quality of what is delivered by the supplier side
Project manager Day-to-day management within the tolerances set by the board
Team manager Delivers the products for the project manager (optional role)
Project assurance Independent checks on behalf of the business, user and supplier interests
Change authority Has delegated authority to approve or reject changes
Project support Administrative help (planning tools, filing, reporting)
Exam tip

. The board is accountable; the project manager manages; the team manager delivers. Project assurance should be independent of the project manager. [Verify live]

5The work breakdown structure

A work breakdown structure (WBS) is a hierarchical breakdown of the total work needed to deliver the project's products, down to manageable pieces that can be assigned and estimated. It shows who does what and supports planning and control.

6Management products

Product Purpose
Project management team structure (PID) The roles and reporting lines of the project
Role descriptions (PID) What each role is responsible for
Commercial management approach (PID) How the project manages suppliers and contracts
Exam tip

. The Executive is the single point of accountability for the project. Do not confuse the Executive with the project manager, who works within tolerances.

Exam tip

. Project assurance is independent: the person who manages the project does not assure it.

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Who is ultimately accountable for the success of the project?

  • AThe project manager
  • BThe team manager
  • CProject support
  • DThe Executive
Show the answer

Answer: D. The Executive is ultimately accountable.

S2Which statements about the project board are CORRECT? (1) It is accountable for the project's success. (2) It includes the Executive, Senior User and Senior Supplier. (3) It manages the project day to day. (4) It is made up only of team managers.

  • A3 and 4
  • B2 and 3
  • C1 and 2
  • D1 and 4
Show the answer

Answer: C. The board is accountable and has those three roles.

S3Identify the missing word. The [ ? ] role represents the user interest and specifies user needs.

  • AExecutive
  • BTeam manager
  • CProject support
  • DSenior User
Show the answer

Answer: D. That is the Senior User.

S4Which role delivers the products for the project manager?

  • ATeam manager
  • BExecutive
  • CChange authority
  • DProject assurance
Show the answer

Answer: A. Team managers deliver the products.

S5A group has delegated authority to approve or reject changes. Which role is this?

  • AChange authority
  • BSenior Supplier
  • CExecutive
  • DProject manager
Show the answer

Answer: A. The change authority decides on changes within its delegated authority.

S6What is a work breakdown structure?

  • AA list of risks
  • BA report to the board
  • CA quality inspection
  • DA hierarchical breakdown of the total work to be done
Show the answer

Answer: D. It breaks the total work into manageable pieces.

7.2 Recall questions

R1Name the three project interests.

Show the answer

Business, user and supplier.

R2Who makes up the project board?

Show the answer

The Executive, Senior User(s) and Senior Supplier(s).

R3What does project assurance do?

Show the answer

Independent checks on the business, user and supplier interests.

R4What is the project manager's authority limited by?

Show the answer

The tolerances set by the project board.

R5Which PID product describes how suppliers and contracts are handled?

Show the answer

The commercial management approach.

R6What does a role description state?

Show the answer

What each role is responsible for.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Interests business (Executive), user (Senior User), supplier (Senior Supplier)
Board accountable; Executive + Senior User + Senior Supplier
Team project manager, team managers, team members, support
Other roles project assurance (independent), change authority, project support
Products team structure, role descriptions, commercial management approach
